margo: Quick reminder — 2.4.1 code freeze at 18:00 PT today. Only emergency/critical fixes after that with explicit approval from release leads.

sam: Noted. I have one tiny dependency bump (protobuf) that I'd like to squeeze in — low risk. Can we do a quick review? @margo

margo: @sam share the PR link and short risk note. If it's only build deps and passes CI I can approve as a late merge.

sam: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-core/pull/4921. Summary: protobuf 3.20 -> 3.21, no API changes for our usage, unit tests pass locally. CI is still running.

kevin: Heads up — if this touches bundle hashes we need to bump the version and update the changelog entry. @sam did you run the version bump script?

sam: not yet, waiting on CI green. I can run the bump after merge, or we can do it in the same PR. Which is preferred?

kevin: prefer same PR so release artifacts stay consistent. Add a line in CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased" with a one-liner.

linh: @margo are we accepting late merges for non-security infra deps? We should keep a hard line or we'll get a flood.

margo: We're keeping the line hard, but low-risk infra deps that don't change runtime behavior can be allowed if small and CI/QA signs off. This one seems borderline — let's wait for CI results.

release-bot: [schedule] Release 2.4.1: freeze=2026-03-17 18:00:00 PT, deploy-window=2026-03-18 02:00:00 PT. To request exception, use /release-exception with PR link + justification.

ryan: If we approve, please tag the merge commit with v2.4.1-hotfix. I can handle the promo and artifact publishing during the deploy window.

ana: small nit — the changelog line should include the PR number so automation picks it up. Example: "Fix: bump protobuf to 3.21 (PR #4921)"

sam: CI is green now. I added the changelog line and ran `scripts/bump-version.sh --patch`. Here's the commit: 7c2a1f4.

kevin: quick review done, looks safe. Approving for late merge. @margo can you confirm?

margo: Approved. Merge and push the tag. Keep an eye on canary after deploy and report any regressions in #incidents. :thumbsup:

sam: Merged and tagged v2.4.1-hotfix. Commands I ran:
``n``git checkout main
``git pull origin main
``git merge --no-ff 4921
``scripts/bump-version.sh --patch
``git push origin main --tags
``n
sam: Thanks all. I'll monitor canary and loop back if anything odd shows up.

ryan: I'll run promo and watch metrics during the 02:00 PT window. If anything spikes I'll rollback and notify here.

margo: Thanks team. Reminder: use /release-exception for any future late merges so we have a record.

linh: Noted.

release-bot: [event] Exception approved: PR #4921 by margo at 2026-03-17T17:24:10Z
